messages:
maria: FYI saw three short latency spikes yesterday across prod-gpu pools; this exposed a gap in our operational observability. Want to propose a combined latency+throughput Ops SLO and an automated error-budget trigger.

maria: short summary: p95 went from ~120ms -> ~380ms for 30-90s windows at 03:14, 11:02, 18:20 UTC. Throughput (req/s) also jumped ~2x during windows. Error-budget burned ~10% for the route set. Postmortem ticket: PM-2026-438.

aj: +1 to combined SLO idea. We currently only have latency p95 30d target. Suggest adding: 24h rolling p95 and 6h throughput-stability SLO (to catch bursts). Example draft config: 
```
nservice: model-serve
primary_slos:
  - metric: latency.p95_ms
    window: 30d
    target_ms: 150
  - metric: latency.p95_ms
    window: 24h
    target_ms: 165
  - metric: throughput.stability_pct
    window: 6h
    target_pct: 95
```

devon: good. For throughput.stability_pct define it as percent of 1m buckets within 10% of rolling median. Also instrument KV cache miss rate and per-request batch size; I can add those metrics.

sophie: I'll check product/Sales SLA docs for customer-facing thresholds. If we add a 24h op SLO, we need comms that it's not a contract change. I'll coordinate with legal.

kevin: I'll own the alerting + dashboard work. Plan: add 3m/15m p95 panels, a 6h throughput stability panel, and a single-number "error-budget burn rate (6h)" widget. PD rule: if 6h burn rate > 4x AND 24h SLO breached -> page latency-oncall immediately. ETA: 36h.

maria: propose automated actions when error-budget triggers: 1) pause all non-critical rollouts; 2) auto-create an incident if severity S3+; 3) notify Product + Sales. Anyone object?

aj: +0. No objection. We should add a manual override for emergency hotfixes.

devon: for runbook: add quick checks in order: KV miss rate, batch size spikes, pool CPU/GPU contention, recent autoscaler events, recent job workloads hitting same nodes. I'll draft a checklist.

sophie: I'll own stakeholder comms and make a short FAQ for customers explaining operational SLO vs contractual SLA.

kevin: tasks created in tracker: T-821 dashboard+alerts (kevin, 36h); T-822 24h/6h SLO config + eval (aj, 5d); T-823 automation for rollout pause & incident create (maria, 7d); T-824 telemetry KV misses & batch hist (devon, 10d); T-825 customer comms + FAQ (sophie, 4d).
